caption: The drawing shows two clear glass bottles, both cylindrical with rounded shoulders and threaded necks. The bottle on the left is larger and has floral decorations painted on its front, featuring blue, red, yellow, pink, and green colors arranged in a symmetrical bouquet with a central brown element. Surrounding the main floral motif are additional floral patterns and swirls painted in white. Red and yellow diagonal stripes run along the vertical edges of the bottle. The bottle on the right is smaller, also decorated with vertical stripes in blue, red, and yellow on its edges. Its front displays floral designs in similar colors (red, blue, yellow, white, green), with the addition of a small white bird at the bottom sitting among yellow-centered flowers. The drawing is set against an off-white background with no additional objects or scenery included.
title: Flint Glass Bottles
